en: Giovanni
So. You have come all this way at last.
Team Rocket's hideout, the Pokémon Tower, Silph Co. Every time, it was you who stood in my way.
This is my Gym. Here I am its Leader, and nothing more. Show me whether you were lucky, or whether you are strong.
Giovanni
Ha! There is no luck in that. You are strong, and I am beaten.
Take the Earth Badge. It is proof that you have beaten the Leader of the Viridian City Gym.
{player} received the Earth Badge from Giovanni!
With the Earth Badge, every Pokémon will obey you, whatever its level. It is the last of Kanto's eight.
Take this as well. Use it as you see fit.
TM26 is Earthquake. It shakes the whole ground, and very little can stand against it.
Having lost to you, I can no longer face the people who followed me.
Team Rocket is finished. I shall go away alone and train, as I once did, until I understand what I have lacked.
Should we meet again one day, it will be as trainers. Farewell, child.
Guide
Hey, champ in the making! Nobody knows much about the Leader of this Gym. They say he's away more often than not.
His Pokémon fight with the strength of the earth itself. Water and Grass moves will serve you well. And watch your step on those arrows!
Blew me away! You beat the mysterious Leader and won all eight Badges. The Pokémon League is waiting for you now!
Viridian City Pokémon Gym. Leader: ?. Winning trainers: {rival}.
Viridian City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Giovanni. Winning trainers: {rival}, {player}.
